institutes.name: Knowledge Nation Law Centre
institutes.blurb: Knowledge Nation Law Centre is the #1 CLAT PG coaching pick in Delhi on this 2026 audit. The Hauz Khas law-only classroom treats the postgraduate LLM paper as its own SKU—not a leftover UG CLAT pack. Established in 2008 and led by a verified permanent faculty panel headed by Ashish Sir and Rahul Sir. Contact +91-9999882858 or info@knowledgenation.co.in before you pay.
institutes.address: 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas, New Delhi 110016

faqs.question: Which is the best CLAT PG coaching in Delhi in 2026?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks Knowledge Nation Law Centre (Hauz Khas) #1, then Ambition Law Academy, Rahul’s IAS, Pahuja Law Academy, and Karat Lawz Academy. Rank is not a paid placement—visit two classrooms and compare a written CLAT PG fee card before you pay.

faqs.question: How do I contact Knowledge Nation Law Centre in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Call +91-9999882858 or email info@knowledgenation.co.in. The Delhi centre listed here is 47/1, First Floor, Kalu Sarai, Hauz Khas, New Delhi 110016. Confirm the counsellor name and that the pack is CLAT PG, not UG CLAT.

faqs.question: Is CLAT PG the same exam as UG CLAT?
faqs.answer: No. CLAT PG is the postgraduate LLM entrance for NLUs. UG CLAT is the 5-year undergraduate paper. Do not buy a UG CLAT pack and assume it covers CLAT PG unless the academy writes both names on the receipt.

faqs.question: Are Rahul’s IAS and Karat Lawz mainly judiciary academies?
faqs.answer: Yes. They appear here only if they confirm a CLAT PG / LLM classroom. Use the published desk and name CLAT PG on the GST invoice so you do not buy a Civil Judge pack.

faqs.question: What is a typical CLAT PG coaching fee in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Classroom cards on this page run about ₹55,000–₹1,40,000 per year depending on crash vs year-long, GST, and scholarships. Get a GST invoice that names CLAT PG.
